text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d l-o-c-k-o-u-t d-e-v-i-c-e-s t-o d-e-n-y t-e-n-a-n-t a-c-c-e-s-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l b-a-r-r-i-e-r-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d l-a-w-f-u-l e-v-i-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-v-i-c-e-d u-t-i-l-i-t-y s-u-p-p-l-i-e-s, r-e-s-u-l-t-i-n-g i-n s-e-r-v-i-c-e t-e-r-m-i-n-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, b-u-t i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g h-a-b-i-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d i-n-t-i-m-i-d-a-t-i-n-g c-o-r-r-e-s-p-o-n-d-e-n-c-e, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g d-a-t-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, y-e-t o-v-e-r-s-i-g-h-t-i-n-g f-f-e l-a-w-f-u-l n-o-t-i-c-e f-o-r-m-a-t r-u-l-e-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-g-r-a-d-e-d u-n-i-t c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g s-e-v-e-r-e l-i-v-i-n-g d-e-f-i-c-i-e-n-c-y, a-n-d f-a-i-l-e-d t-o p-e-r-f-o-r-m b-a-s-i-c m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e d-u-t-i-e-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-v-o-i-d-e-d i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n v-i-s-i-t-s, m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-i-n-g h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e n-e-g-l-e-c-t-i-n-g m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
